visual_goal: Show the documented sources on the left feeding the documented product surfaces on the right, with the register feeding every surface.
prompt: A left-to-right map. Right column, five plain generic product panels stacked vertically from top to bottom: 'Dealer workspace', 'Appraisal reports', 'XML interfaces', 'Market insight', 'Plate check'. Left column, four plain generic source blocks, placed so that arrows do not cross: at the very top, level with 'Dealer workspace', a small block labeled 'Advert data'; below it a large prominent blue register-book block labeled 'RDW register' spanning the middle height; below that a document-stack block labeled 'Licensed specs'; at the bottom a block labeled 'Damage sources'. Arrows: one short straight orange arrow from 'Advert data' directly right into 'Dealer workspace'. Five blue arrows fan out from 'RDW register', one into each of the five right-hand panels. Two teal arrows from 'Licensed specs': one into 'Appraisal reports' and one into 'XML interfaces'. One green arrow from 'Damage sources' into 'Appraisal reports'. Each arrow keeps its own color from start to end and never merges with another arrow. These nine labels are the only words in the image.
alt: Four sources on the left (RDW register, licensed specifications, damage sources, advert data) feed five product surfaces on the right; the register feeds all five.

visual_goal: Contrast per-source schemas, which put each licensor's structure in front of the client, with one harmonized vehicle resource that keeps the source as provenance on each field.
prompt: A two-band comparison, top band and bottom band separated by a thin horizontal line. Top band: at left a generic laptop labeled 'Client'; one arrow labeled 'plate' to a document box labeled 'XML request'; from 'XML request' four arrows fan out to four plain identical grey boxes stacked vertically on the right, labeled 'RDW types', 'Jato types', 'DAT types', 'Autotelex types'. Bottom band: at left a generic laptop labeled 'Client'; one arrow labeled 'plate or VIN' to a single large teal card labeled 'One vehicle resource'; one arrow from it to a list card on the right showing several field rows, each row with a small source tag, labeled 'Fields with source'. All boxes are plain generic shapes with text only. These ten labels are the only words in the image.
alt: Top: a client sends a plate in an XML request that fans out to four per-source schemas. Bottom: a client sends a plate or VIN to one vehicle resource whose fields each carry their source.

visual_goal: Show that the provider outputs only plate-level scores while personal data stays in the dealer's own customer file.
prompt: A left-to-right swimlane illustration with three vertical lanes, each headed by a simple generic icon and a label: a generic server box labeled 'Data provider', a generic dealership building labeled 'Dealer', a locked filing cabinet labeled 'Customer file'. Arrows from top to bottom, in this order: a small loop arrow on 'Data provider' labeled 'score plates'; one arrow from 'Data provider' to 'Dealer' labeled 'flagged plates'; one arrow from 'Dealer' to 'Customer file' labeled 'match plates'; one return arrow from 'Customer file' to 'Dealer' labeled 'own customers'; a small loop arrow on 'Dealer' labeled 'contact'. A faint vertical dashed boundary separates the 'Data provider' lane from the other two. These eight labels are the only words in the image.
alt: Swimlanes for data provider, dealer and customer file: the provider scores plates and sends only flagged plates; the dealer matches them against its own customer file and contacts its own customers.

visual_goal: Show the direction of the portfolio moves: units bought into the core, a licensed partner platform inside it, and a divested auction business that returns as an external partner.
prompt: A hub illustration. In the center, a large plain teal rounded box with text 'VWE core'. Upper left, a plain box 'AVN Group' with one arrow into 'VWE core' labeled 'absorbed'. Lower left, a plain box 'XRAY' with one arrow into 'VWE core' labeled 'own brand for now'. Top, a plain box 'weDAT' with one arrow down into 'VWE core' labeled 'licensed'. Right, an orange plain box 'ATC auctions'. Between 'VWE core' and 'ATC auctions' there are exactly two arrows: a straight arrow along the lower side from 'VWE core' to 'ATC auctions' labeled 'divested', and a single curved arrow along the upper side from 'ATC auctions' back into 'VWE core' labeled 'partner auctions'. Far right, a plain box 'Autorola' with one arrow from 'ATC auctions' to it labeled 'now owned by'. Every label appears once. All boxes are generic shapes with plain text, no emblems. These twelve labels are the only words in the image.
alt: A hub with VWE core in the center: AVN Group is absorbed, XRAY keeps its own brand for now, weDAT is licensed in; ATC auctions is divested, now owned by Autorola, and returns as partner auctions.
